postconditions.description: There must be at least one postcondition that defines the output.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in postconditions if w_i != 0)
postconditions.description: All edge weights must be positive integers and less than or equal to 10**9, except for the root.

postconditions.expression: all(dist[p_i] < dist[p_{i+1}] for i in range(len(postconditions) - 1))
postconditions.description: The permutation of vertices must be in increasing order of distance from the root.

postconditions.expression: all(w_i == 0 or 1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in postconditions)
postconditions.description: The root has no edge weight.

postconditions.expression: all(w_i != w_j for i != j for w_i in postconditions for w_j in postconditions)
postconditions.description: All edge weights must be unique.
